_about: Verified corrections applied on top of the research-note constants by build_constants.py. Source of each fix: research/notes/08-verification.md (round 1, 2026-10-09). Keys are dotted paths into constants.json. 'do_not_show': true means the value is unverifiable at a primary source and must never appear on screen or in narration.

hardware.other_accelerators.trainium3_hb.note: Per chip, DERIVED: AWS prints UltraServer totals (Gen2, 144 chips: 20,736 GiB HBM, 705.6 TB/s, 362,448 TFLOPS dense MXFP8); divided by 144 gives 144 GiB, 4.9 TB/s, 2.52 PFLOPS per chip. (08-verification item 2)

hardware.other_accelerators.mi355x_hbm.note: HBM3E 288 GB, 8 TB/s, 1400 W. AMD brochure dense peaks: BF16 2.5166 PFLOP/s, FP8 5.0332 PFLOP/s, MXFP4 10.0663 PFLOP/s; peak clock 2.4 GHz. (08-verification item 3)

hardware.memory_tiers.nvme_gen5_seq_read.note: Samsung PM1743, 'up to 14,000 MB/s' on the current Samsung page; PCIe Gen5 x4 link limit 15.76 GB/s. (08-verification item 6)

hardware.memory_tiers.ddr5_6400_12ch_soc.note: AMD EPYC 9005: 12 channels DDR5 up to 6400 MT/s, 614 GB/s per socket peak theoretical. (08-verification item 7)

hardware.interconnect.pcie_gen6_x16_per_.note: PCI-SIG release: 64 GT/s; x16 ≈ 128 GB/s per direction, 256 GB/s both directions (raw). (08-verification item 8)

hardware.H-teach.h100_sxm_bf16_dense.note: Derived: NVIDIA product page prints 1,979 TFLOPS with sparsity; dense = 1979 / 2 = 989.5. Cross-check: the preliminary Hopper whitepaper (https://www.ece.lsu.edu/koppel/gp/refs/gtc22-whitepaper-hopper.pdf) lists BF16 1000 | 2000 TFLOPS dense | sparse. (08-verification item 4)

hardware.H-teach.h100_boost_clock.note: Unverifiable at an NVIDIA primary source (08-verification item 9).

hardware.interconnect.quantum_x800_port_.note: Only a third-party datasheet states sub-100 ns; NVIDIA's page gives no latency (08-verification item 9).

hardware.power.gb200_nvl72_rack_power_no.note: HPE collateral page unreachable; figure seen only in a search summary (08-verification item 9).

models.M-embed.mteb_multilingual_mean_ta.note: Publisher card 70.58; recomputed from mteb/results data (2026-10-08) 70.18. The card's 'No.1' claim dates from June 2025 and is stale: microsoft/harrier-oss-v1-27b (MIT, 27B) scores 74.3. Kept as the Apache-2.0 choice in the 8B class for cost on the TTFT path. (08-verification items 10-11)

models.M-rerank._note: No reranker leaderboard exists; label all M-rerank scores 'publisher-reported' (08-verification item 12).

models.M-vision.max_visual_tokens_per_im.note: NOT the true maximum: the K3 processor reaches 16,817 visual tokens for a 1861×7041 input (data/image_patches.json, Part 04 author). Show the maximum from image_patches data, not this value.
